I replaced every `datetime.utcnow()` with `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` in the five modules under `app/`: `audit.py`, `billing.py`, `cache.py`, `reports.py` and `sessions.py`. Each file now imports `timezone`, and nothing in `app/` or `tests/` still calls `utcnow` (the final grep returned nothing).

All 5 tests pass, and they also pass with `DeprecationWarning` treated as an error.

The returned datetimes are now timezone-aware instead of naive. Any caller that compares them to a naive `datetime` will now raise `TypeError`. Nothing in this repo does that.

`reports.header()` now includes a UTC offset. It used to print `T generated 2026-10-17T20:08:00` and now prints `T generated 2026-10-17T20:08:00+00:00`. The test only checks the `"T generated "` prefix, so it still passes. If something downstream parses that string, it will see the suffix.
